notes.title: Steam Cards and goodies
notes.content:
Hey, did you see that? 
That notification up there? Yeah, that one. It means there are new Hidden Paws Mystery trading cards in your inventory! 
What are you waiting for? Go check them out! 


It also means there are now Hidden Paws Mystery emoticons and badges! Yay!

notes.title: Serbian localization!
notes.content:
Thanks to our awesome community, we now have Serbian language in both Hidden Paws Mystery and Hidden Paws.

Translation kindly provided by Marko "romanizat" Josifović and Radoš "rammba" Milićev! Thank you! :)

Steam unfortunately doesn't support Serbian yet, so the achievements and store descriptions will remain untranslated. We'll make sure to add those when it becomes possible.

notes.title: We're making Summer Paws
notes.content:
Summer Paws will feature all new summer-themed islands for you to explore and enjoy. New hiding spots, interactive environments full of life and puzzles to make searching for cats even more fun.

The game will release around May 2020. Check out the Steam page and wishlist it so you don't miss it!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1150460/Summer_Paws/

notes.title: Hint system for the yarn.
notes.content:
Due to popular demand and in an effort to make the game more pleasant there is now an optional hint system for the yarn :)
 It is turned off by default and has to be enabled in settings for each play session if you want to use it. It won't show you exactly where the yarn is but it will point you to the general area.
  Here's what it looks like:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33562970/e21db9982ab4499839aef091ad5bc33864f45118.gif[/img]

 As usual, we'd love to hear your thoughts on this change, so we can tune it and improve your experience! 

Thanks :)

notes.title: Welcome! :)
notes.content:
My sister and I made a second game! :)
 Much like with Hidden Paws before, you are tasked with exploring beautiful lands in search for hidden cats!
  We hope you'll have a pleasant time. 

 If you run into any issues with the game please do not hestitate to let us know! 

 Have we mentioned how awesome you are? No? Well, you are! 
Your incredible support means we can keep turning our ideas into games. It just wouldn't be possible without you.

Also, thanks to the following members of our community, both Hidden Paws and Hidden Paws Mystery can be enjoyed in many languages:
